resources.string: Local Firebase does not send reset emails. Open the reset link printed in the Start-LocalBackend terminal on your computer. Replace the newPassword value in that link with your chosen password.
The passwords do not match. Please enter them again.
An account already uses this email. Go back to Log in, or reset your password.

Local Firebase is not reachable. On your computer, run scripts/Start-LocalBackend.ps1 and keep that terminal open. For a USB phone, enable USB debugging and run scripts/Connect-TestDevice.ps1. Local accounts are separate from your live Firebase accounts.
Local development does not send email. This button uses a verification code from the local emulator. Real accounts still require inbox verification.
